title: Phase
description: A delivery phase grouping related tasks toward a milestone.

businessValue.description: Business value delivered by completing this phase.

successCriteria.description: What must be true for this phase's milestone to be reached. Worked out with the user at planning and persisted here, because nit:phase-summary verifies the milestone criterion by criterion and matches them by id across runs — criteria that live only in a conversation cannot be verified against, and criteria re-derived each run do not keep stable ids. Optional in the schema so a phase.json written before this field stays valid, but nit:phases writes it for every new phase.

id.description: Stable identifier, SC-1, SC-2, … A criterion's id must mean the same thing on every re-run of the phase summary.

description.description: What must be demonstrably true. Verifiable by inspection or execution, not a restatement of the milestone.
